purpose: A sector spread wide enough to prove that one metric definition cannot span sectors. Each company is here because it breaks something a single definition would assume.
note: XOM is pinned to CIK 0000034088. The ticker resolves to ExxonMobil Holdings Corp (CIK 0002115436), a 2026 reorganisation entity with 94 concepts and zero annual revenue periods, whose entityName still reads 'Exxon Mobil Corporation'.

companies.why: Industrial with a loss year: exercises the non-positive pre-tax guard
Dropped CostOfRevenue after 2017; resolving by preference alone returns a nine-year-old figure
Migrated capex and revenue concepts; the old capex tag last appears in 2012
Stopped tagging GrossProfit after 2019, so gross profit must be derived
No cost of revenue at all; also the ticker-to-entity trap
Reports InterestIncomeExpenseNet, last in 2013, where it means nothing
Railroad: reports CostsAndExpenses but no cost of revenue
Utility: tags no cash capex under any standard concept
Telecom in the 4800s that files like a general company, unlike transport in the 4000s
Bank: contract revenue returns a fee subset fifteen times too small
Insurance: no cost of revenue, and free cash flow is not meaningful
REIT: tags PaymentsToAcquireRealEstate, which is buying buildings, not maintaining them
